environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance with an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in front. WebSocket connections are passed through directly at L4. No origin validation middleware. Application accessible on port 443 via NLB TCP passthrough. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no L7 inspection)
